definition: A step of the house's journey not yet reached, drawn as a dashed ring. Nothing is wrong with it; the house simply has not got there, and the step may not open until the one before it is done.
basis: docs/ui-redesign-2026-10-29.md, the journey marks: "dashed graphite ring / dashed" outline for a step not yet reached. workbench/app/src/theme/tokens.css says why none of the three borrows a verdict's form: "Not a verdict, so no judgment's form."
